aeropad.description:
AeroPad turns any Android phone (Android 10+) into a real Bluetooth input device — keyboard, mouse/trackpad, air mouse, numpad, media remote, presenter, Android-TV remote and HID gamepad — for PCs, laptops, TVs, tablets and consoles, using Android's Bluetooth HID Device API so the host needs no software at all.

Around that core it's a full control-surface studio: a drag-and-drop layout editor (buttons, trackpads, joysticks, sliders, D-pads, zone splitter, per-widget styling and action binding), multi-device profiles so each host remembers its own layout, macros, shortcut decks, Quick Text/clipboard tools, Pro gamepad with gyro aim/tilt steering and per-game tuning, Touch Screen digitizer mode, and Light/Dark/System plus Glass/Neon themes.
